items.t: Voted Nay on both of Sen. Sanders's April 2025 resolutions to block arms sales to Israel. Both failed.
Voted Nay on both July 2025 resolutions to block weapons sales and exports to Israel, which most of the Democratic caucus supported. Both failed.
Voted Yea on both April 2026 resolutions to block arms sales to Israel. Both failed.
Voted Yea to force a State Department report on Israel's human rights practices (S.Res. 852). It failed 47–51; the Democratic caucus voted 46–1.
Voted Nay on taking up H.R. 23, which sanctions the International Criminal Court. It failed 54–45; the Democratic caucus voted 1–45.
Track AIPAC counts $5,611,163 in pro-Israel lobby money to his campaigns over his career.
